rating_change_conditions: Restore valuation support only after a full review verifies trial and regulatory status by program, development timing and cost, technical and approval probabilities, partner milestone and royalty economics, current cash runway, Tempus obligations, financing needs and fully diluted shares, then supplies ordered bear, base and bull risk-adjusted-NPV assumptions with probabilities totaling 100. Upgrade timing only if the resulting expected-return, base-return, payoff and margin-of-safety gates clear; downgrade the thesis if clinical safety or efficacy disappoints, programs are deprioritized, partner economics remain immaterial, burn accelerates or dilution overwhelms program value.
